headline: Hormuz tanker attacks and Gulf hurricane send fuel prices sharply higher
intro: Diesel at $4.71 a gallon wholesale and retail pump prices north of $6 — the fuels market is having a moment, and not the good kind. Escalating Hormuz tanker attacks and a hurricane bearing down on the Gulf Coast are doing the kind of double-duty on prices that traders dream about and everyone else dreads.
overview: Crude and refined products rallied sharply Thursday as Iran-linked tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz collided with a hurricane threat shutting in roughly a quarter of US Gulf production, pushing diesel cracks above $100/bbl and gasoline cracks near $46/bbl. Ukrainian drone strikes on Russia's Omsk and Salavat refineries added to global supply anxiety, while Venezuela's Cardón refinery resumed operations after a fire. On the policy side, EPA moved to restore lost RFS demand from refinery exemptions, Cummins warned against Texas's diesel sulfur waiver, and diesel's historic premium over gasoline continued to draw political and consumer scrutiny.

stories.title: NYMEX Overview: Petroleum Futures Move Sharply Higher as Hurricane, War Raise Supply Uncertainty -- OPIS
stories.summary: Crude and refined product futures jumped sharply Thursday morning on prospects of renewed US-Iran fighting and a hurricane threatening Gulf Coast production, per OPIS.

stories.title: Oil jumps 5% as Hormuz tanker attacks escalate, US Gulf hurricane shuts in production
stories.summary: Oil jumped 5% as Hormuz tanker attacks escalated alongside US Gulf hurricane preparations that forced production shut-ins, pushing Brent and WTI higher.

stories.title: Crude, Diesel, And Storm Risks: Key Drivers Behind Today's Rally
stories.summary: Energy markets rallied again Thursday as war-related supply impacts and the season's first Gulf hurricane threat both drove the move, per TACenergy.

stories.title: How Diesel Went From Cheaper Than Gasoline To Much More Expensive
stories.summary: Diesel has flipped from historically cheaper than gasoline to a much larger premium, driven by tighter fuel standards, taxes, global demand, and distillate shortages.

stories.title: Trump's Iran war is costing us. Voters can make the GOP pay | Opinion
stories.summary: GasBuddy's Patrick De Haan noted diesel's 'fuel clock' hit a new high amid what the piece frames as costs from the Iran conflict.

stories.title: Why soaring diesel prices could hit your wallet in unexpected ways
stories.summary: Soaring diesel prices are poised to trickle down through the economy given diesel's role in trucking and agriculture, per USA Today.

stories.title: GOP efforts to lower gas prices derailed by Republican infighting
stories.summary: GOP efforts to lower gas prices ahead of Election Day stalled in the Senate amid Republican infighting.

stories.title: EIA: US crude oil inventories down 3.2 million bbl
stories.summary: EIA reported US crude oil inventories fell 3.2 million bbl to 424.1 million bbl, about 1% above the five-year average.

stories.title: Mixed outlook for energy expenditures this winter
stories.summary: EIA's winter outlook sees mixed energy expenditures, with higher heating-oil prices increasing costs for households using that fuel while natural gas and propane users see declines.

stories.title: Drone attack reported at Russia's largest oil refinery; Ukrainian manufacturer claims FP-1 involvement
stories.summary: A drone attack hit Russia's Omsk refinery, the country's largest, with a Ukrainian manufacturer claiming its FP-1 drone was involved.

stories.title: Ukraine strikes major oil refinery and petrochemical complex in Bashkortostan
stories.summary: Ukraine's armed forces said a strike caused a fire at Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat, a strategic Russian refining and petrochemical complex in Bashkortostan.

stories.title: Update: Venezuela's Cardon refinery resuming crude distillation after fire
stories.summary: Venezuela's 310,000-b/d Cardón refinery was restarting crude distillation units after a fire forced a shutdown earlier in the week.

stories.title: US EPA begins process to restore lost RFS demand from refinery exemptions
stories.summary: US EPA began the process to restore RFS demand lost to refinery small-refiner exemptions, with IRFA urging timely finalization to avoid rural market uncertainty.

stories.title: Cummins warns EPA's Texas diesel waiver risks engine damage
stories.summary: Cummins warned that EPA's temporary Texas diesel sulfur waiver could damage modern engines and void warranties if unapproved fuel is used.
